title: AI OS Agent Handoff Schema
description: Schema for structured handoff packets between agents. A handoff is valid only when the receiving agent can continue work without ambiguity.

handoff_id.description: Unique ID for this handoff instance

trace_id.description: Correlation ID linking all events in the task chain

task_id.description: ID of the task being handed off

from_agent.description: Agent ID of the sender (e.g. A06)

to_agent.description: Agent ID of the receiver (e.g. A07)

state.description: The workflow phase this handoff represents

objective.description: Clear statement of the task objective for the receiving agent

acceptance_criteria.description: Explicit, testable acceptance criteria the receiver must verify

context_snapshot_id.description: Reference to the versioned context snapshot from A02

artifacts.description: All artifacts being transferred in this handoff

store_ref.description: Reference to artifact in Artifact Store

dependencies.description: Known dependencies of the transferred artifacts

open_issues.description: Known unresolved issues the receiver must be aware of

quality_evidence.description: Evidence packages supporting the quality of transferred artifacts

budget_consumption.description: Budget used by the sending agent up to this handoff point

required_decision.description: The decision the receiving agent is expected to make

deadline.description: ISO-8601 UTC deadline for the receiver to respond. Null if no deadline.

rules: Sender must include complete context snapshot ID
Sender must include all artifacts and their metadata
Sender must include all known risks and open issues
Receiver must acknowledge within the deadline (if set)
Receiver may accept, reject, or conditionally accept
Rejection must include reason and required fixes
If receiver does not acknowledge, Orchestrator reassigns or escalates
All handoffs are versioned and audited in the Audit Log
